soldier: The soldier has the head brown, the frontal surface deeper, mandibles blackish brown, labrum and antennae brown, eye spots yellow, pronotum brown and deeper than the back of the head, abdomen and legs pale brownish yellow, tibiae and tarsi darker. Head cylindrical, the sides parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. In profile the dorsolateral angle of the frons strongly raised, the frontal slope more than 70 degrees, the dorsal margin of the head sloping gently from the top of the frons to the back of the head; the frontal surface with a V-shaped depression, the Y-shaped suture faintly visible, the median suture slightly depressed. Compound eyes small and dot-like, their distance to the antennal socket more than about twice their own short diameter. Labrum semicircular, the tips of the mandibles rather stout and curved, the left mandible slightly longer than the right but less than half the head capsule. Antennae with 12 segments, the second and third rather short. The postmentum widest near the midpoint, the waist region at about the posterior third. The anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad V-shaped concavity, the sides parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded with a shallow median notch.
